clauses.clause: When this creature enters, it deals 1 damage to any target.
clauses.evidence: [cast]: ask target over [you_bear, you_giant, opp_flier, opp_tapped, opp_bear, opp_giant, card, you, opp] (every creature, itself, both players); each pick is dealt 1 by card/DEAL_DAMAGE (opp_flier dies, 'card' damage 0 -> 1, you: life 20 -> 19). Fires again on MOVE_ZONE entry during the opponent's turn. Cost B-1 W-3, body 3/3.
